print_editions.desc_ar: مَتْنُ الْعَقِيدَةِ الْوَاسِطِيَّةِ مَضْبُوطًا بِالشَّكْلِ الْكَامِلِ، مُهَيَّأٌ لِلطِّبَاعَةِ بِنُسْخَةِ الْقِرَاءَةِ الدَّوْلِيَّةِ وَنُسْخَةِ طَالِبِ الْعِلْمِ ذَاتِ الْهَامِشِ الْوَاسِعِ لِلتَّعْلِيقِ.
print_editions.desc_en: Ibn Taymiyyah's foundational creed primer with full harakat, typeset for global paperback (6×9 in) and Cairo wide-margin student note-taking (17×24 cm).
print_editions.desc_fr: Le texte fondamental de croyance d'Ibn Taymiyyah avec voyellisation complète (harakat), mis en page en format poche international (6×9 po) et édition d'étude à larges marges (17×24 cm).

print_editions.desc_ar: مَدْخَلٌ مُيَسَّرٌ فِي التَّوْحِيدِ مَضْبُوطٌ بِالشَّكْلِ الْكَامِلِ، مُنَاسِبٌ لِلْمُبْتَدِئِينَ فِي طَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ وَاللُّغَةِ الْعَرَبِيَّةِ، مَعَ تَنْبِيهٍ وَاضِحٍ عَلَى الْأَحَادِيثِ الضَّعِيفَةِ.
print_editions.desc_en: An accessible, clearly structured introduction to Tawḥīd with full harakat—ideal for beginners in Arabic and Islamic studies, with clear hadith grading markers.
print_editions.desc_fr: Une introduction claire et structurée au Tawḥīd avec harakat complètes, idéale pour les débutants en arabe et en sciences islamiques.

print_editions.desc_ar: شَرْحٌ مُيَسَّرٌ وَمُشَجَّرٌ عَلَى الْمُقَدِّمَةِ الْآجُرُّومِيَّةِ بِالتَّشْكِيلِ الْكَامِلِ مَعَ جَدَاوِلَ وَتَشْجِيرَاتٍ نَحْوِيَّةٍ وَتَمَارِينَ تَطْبِيقِيَّةٍ لِلْمُبْتَدِئِينَ.
print_editions.desc_en: A clear, beginner-friendly commentary on al-Ājurrūmiyyah with full harakat, structured grammar tables, visual trees, and exercises.
print_editions.desc_fr: Un commentaire clair et accessible d'al-Ājurrūmiyyah avec harakat complètes, tableaux de grammaire, schémas et exercices pour débutants.
